method: Prespecified synthetic journal states passed through actual SessionJournal.completionSnapshot and LightFinishService.finish. One per-instance validateIfNeeded override returns frozen required invocations and task IDs; automatic selection/execution/refresh are bypassed. Actual snapshot freshness, journal deduplication, failed-code guard, exact identity, observed test predicate, scope and obligations, and completion notifications are unchanged. Scratch production-code mutants are materialized only for solver witnesses.
limits: Finite two-identity domain; no arbitrary program proof.
Journal events are constructed through recordValidation; stale matching-revision file hashes are intentionally adversarial and may not arise through ordinary runner calls.
Runner output parsing, process execution, scheduling, environment provenance and concurrent writers are outside the model.
Passing build path membership reflects current harness admission behavior; it does not prove semantic coverage or user acceptance.
No model calls, source correctness, task success, token/cost benefit or runtime solver integration demonstrated.

timing.scope: One local wall-clock execution, host contention unknown. Scratch-copy/setup and filesystem snapshots dominate runtime measurements; solver/enumeration timings are separate in model.json.
